question: Five people, A, D, E, F and K, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A is the immediate neighbour of D and E. F is the immediate neighbour of E and K. Who is the immediate neighbour of both A and F?
solution:
**Given:** Five people, A, D, E, F and K, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) A is the immediate neighbour of D and E. 

As position of D and E with respect to A is not known yet, therefore there are two possible cases.

Case 1)

Case 2)

2) F is the immediate neighbour of E and K. 

Case 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c18111402c0c64b1dc5a9bf5918be58966042fd5b9a16a5edeafa3555701f77f.png] 

Case 2) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36908d8b7605b9aaf85d5499f8d40ccd98e56746792ecf0e392e62abcc75767b.png] 

Thus, in both cases E is the immediate neighbour of both A and F.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
